title: CBRE Group (CBRE) Sees Deal Volume Jump As Undervalued Narrative Holds
summary: CBRE Group (CBRE) is in focus after reporting that U.S. commercial real estate investment volume reached US$257.8b in Q3 2026, almost double a year earlier and helped by two large entity-level deals. Despite the strong Q3 investment data, CBRE Group’s share price tells a more mixed story. The stock is trading at US$132.54, with the 30-day share price return up 2.85% but the year-to-date move down 17.26%, while the 3-year total shareholder return of 69.62% points to much stronger longer term...

title: CBRE: Q3 Investment Volume Jumps 98% to $257.8B
summary: Two $104 billion entity-level deals nearly doubled Q3 CRE investment volume to $257.8 billion, while underlying market activity grew 18%.
